## Analyzers (1)

### Macadress `v1.0`
Identify the vendor, inferred device category, virtualization, special-use role and MAC-randomization confidence of a MAC address using macadress.com.

- **Author:** Samy Massoud
- **License:** AGPL-V3
- **Data Types:** `mac`, `other`
- **Configuration:** [View config](https://github.com/TheHive-Project/Cortex-Analyzers/blob/master/analyzers/Macadress/Macadress.json)
